scope: Move selected external-sort merge rows without deep-cloning them.
Append canonical JSON recursively into one output string while preserving the existing wire format.

comparison_method.pairing: serial pairs; variant order reverses on alternating repeats
comparison_method.wall_metric: GNU time wall_seconds; medians recomputed from three measurements
comparison_method.rss_metric: maximum GNU time RSS across the three measurements, bytes
comparison_method.output_equivalence: simulation JSON, normalized events.csv, and normalized summary.csv hashes identical across all attempts
comparison_method.manifest: four standard result files independently verified against their manifest entries by the measurement runner
comparison_method.environment_qualification: WSL2 measurement environment; no native reference-machine claim

merge_only_3200.qualification: Scaled-input optimization comparison; no million-request acceptance verdict.

final_16000.qualification: Scaled-input optimization comparison; no million-request acceptance verdict.

final_3200_high.qualification: Scaled-input optimization comparison; no million-request acceptance verdict.

final_3200_overload.qualification: Scaled-input optimization comparison; no million-request acceptance verdict.

profile_interpretation.sampling_overhead: perf call-graph sampling perturbs the run; use profiles to prioritize investigation, not as an uninstrumented duration estimate
profile_interpretation.cumulative_rows: cumulative percentages overlap and must not be summed

actual_million_profile.qualification: 60-second stopped sampling prefix; not a formal performance acceptance run

local_only_raw_perf_data.note: Binary and raw perf.data files remain outside the repository; paths and SHA-256 hashes are recorded here.

calculation.crc_input: SOF through data field, before CRC sequence
calculation.period_rounding: ceil(sum(C_i) / rho), using exact rational arithmetic

generation.provenance: Deterministic analytic Classical CAN timing inputs; CRC-15 register and polynomial-division calculations agree. This does not claim simulator execution, performance, hardware capture, or ISO conformance.

limitations: Scaled comparisons do not prove the optimized binary completes the full million-request workload within 120 seconds.
The actual-million profile is a 60-second stopped prefix; completion time and full-run peak RSS remain unverified.
Perf percentages are sampled, call-graph profiles under WSL2; cumulative rows overlap.
No ISO conformance, hardware timing, or native reference-machine claim is made.

path_conventions.copied_artifact_paths: Paths in support_files, measurement_runners, and support_path fields are relative to support_directory.
path_conventions.input_files: File paths inside each inputs entry are relative to that entry support_directory.
path_conventions.local_artifact_paths: Absolute local paths are provenance references; large comparison outputs were removed after verification.
